records.title: Five dynamic-cylinder designs pass independent numerical qualification
records.summary: Five accepted synthetic port configurations now drive coupled cylinder mass, energy, pressure and temperature through one zero-heat revolution. Independent numerical and saved-data checks pass; execution-monitor qualification is complete. Fuel and heat-release qualification remains ahead. Physical engine performance is unvalidated.
records.evidence: Accepted five-design synthetic numerical milestone · no physical validation

records.title: Five source contours reach a common synthetic flow comparison
records.summary: The five accepted G001 layouts now drive a shared 3,000 rpm prescribed-reservoir experiment. Independent adapter and saved-data checks pass. Stream mass and enthalpy comparisons retain actual aperture histories; cylinder feedback, scavenging and engine performance remain unvalidated.
records.evidence: Qualified synthetic geometry-to-flow comparison · static saved-data package accepted

records.title: Five generated port configurations become traceable comparisons
records.summary: Five complete synthetic exhaust/transfer layouts passed numerical and geometric-distinctness checks, with separate saved-data review. Rectangle, earlier exhaust, taper, split exhaust and staged transfers retain actual contours. The separate Rhino startup gate failed; no candidate CAD or manufacturing acceptance followed.
records.evidence: Accepted generated and numerically verified synthetic geometry · candidate CAD blocked

records.title: Fuel-source qualification remains at its execution gate
records.summary: A bounded execution-control diagnostic remained incomplete. No fuel-energy model or numerical qualification matrix ran, and the coupled gate remains locked. Later independent geometry and flow work does not qualify fuel-derived heat or combustion.
records.evidence: Reviewed incomplete diagnostic · no new fuel-model qualification

records.title: Targets, hardware and missing inputs become explicit
records.summary: Source-checked registers distinguish 12 hardware categories, 11 targets, 14 missing-input records and a 10-module development roadmap. References, candidates, unknowns and fit limits remain separate. Objectives are not predicted performance, safety limits or newly selected hardware.
records.evidence: Accepted bounded source-register review · physical performance not calculated

records.title: Nine stored studies expose the next qualification boundary
records.summary: Nine synthetic combinations and an exact historical baseline reproduction are retained for read-only comparison. Independent saved-data checks pass, but zero of nine independent trajectory checks ran before the supervision window expired. The input domain remains NOT QUALIFIED and Run is disabled. A separate geometry-export attempt produced no mesh.
records.evidence: Reviewed saved numerical evidence and tested private inspection · qualification incomplete

records.title: Saved results gain a tested read-only inspection interface
records.summary: The earlier offline packages remain historical data checks. A later private interface now passes actual desktop/mobile review of saved plots, independent clocks, references and controls. The latest stored-study comparison also passes read-only review. This does not qualify new calculations, genuine web 3D or engine physics.
records.evidence: Later actual private browser review · earlier offline-only checks retained

records.title: Prescribed energy joins the moving-volume gas model
records.summary: A bounded accepted source-energy increment now acts within the same calculation as volume, port-controlled flow and gas state, with separate heat, work and enthalpy ledgers. Original failures and corrections remain preserved. The energy is prescribed; combustion, fuel delivery and engine performance are not validated.
records.evidence: Accepted synthetic prescribed-energy integration · not combustion

records.title: Moving volume and gas exchange share one stage clock
records.summary: A further accepted increment couples nominal piston-driven volume, synthetic port flow, gas mass, energy and passive-species inventories. Independent state, work and transport checks pass after a preserved test correction. No firing engine, physical clearance or manufacturing acceptance is established.
records.evidence: Accepted synthetic moving-volume software · physical validation pending

records.title: Synthetic port opening now controls pressure-driven flow
records.summary: The accepted fixed-volume increment connects nominal piston travel and synthetic aperture to pressure-driven flow and evolving gas state. Four fixtures pass independent geometry, event, flow and conservation checks. This is bounded numerical software, without real port or engine-performance validation.
records.evidence: Accepted synthetic port-controlled flow gate · physical applicability unresolved

records.title: Synthetic gas-state and pressure-flow modules pass bounded gates
records.summary: Separate accepted modules now cover closed-mass state changes, prescribed heat, open mass/energy/passive-species accounting and a fixed-volume pressure-driven transaction. Original failures and corrections remain in the evidence. These are synthetic numerical capabilities, not a validated firing engine or real port design.
records.evidence: Accepted bounded software modules and verified archive receipts · physical validation pending

records.title: An acoustic accuracy upgrade and an explicit one-way interface
records.summary: A restricted aligned linear-acoustic benchmark greatly reduces the earlier method’s numerical diffusion. A separate held-volume provider and phase-gated boundary also pass, with acoustic work assigned to an external driver. No globally conservative cylinder/exhaust engine or real exhaust performance is established.
records.evidence: Accepted synthetic waveform, energy and interface checks · restricted domain

records.title: A finite supervised experiment runner passes its pilot
records.summary: The sequential runner qualified recovery, checked reporting and owned-work protection for six input records: four results and two expected rejections. Its single pilot completed in about 25 seconds. This demonstrates the bounded workload, without claiming long endurance, sleep/reboot recovery or unattended operation.
records.evidence: Accepted supervised finite-workload qualification · longer operation untested

records.title: Repairing the boundary between saved evidence and CAD identity
records.summary: The later port workflow observed nominal motion but retained an incomplete full runtime gate. Reviews isolated layer renumbering and cross-runtime floating-number text as distinct persistence/evidence issues. Offline policy and serialization corrections passed their bounded checks, while a fresh complete runtime demonstration remains unverified.
records.evidence: Reviewed runtime failure and accepted offline components · not full CAD acceptance

records.title: A verified synthetic port-timing study
records.summary: Forty synthetic fixture groups and 542 applicable frozen checks passed before the authorized two-family, 18-context geometric comparison. The result supports nominal timing, opening and numerical reasoning; it does not select a cylinder, predict power or establish manufacturing readiness.
records.evidence: Accepted bounded synthetic software comparison · physical applicability unresolved

records.title: Nominal Python motion reaches actual Rhino geometry
records.summary: An accepted working-copy demonstration read back 361 actual CAD poses against the unchanged 0.001 mm threshold, including saved/reopened correspondence and 11 rejection/rollback cases. The copied partial piston and synthetic mechanism establish software integration, without physical engine validation.
records.evidence: Accepted nominal software/geometry correspondence · not an assembled engine

records.title: Documenting the simulator's verified migration
records.summary: A source review of the accepted migration record confirms a dedicated simulator home, verified local execution and preserved originals. The same 542-check numerical regression suite passed again, alongside 39 storage checks; 245 inventoried originals remained unchanged. This is relocation and evidence-preservation work. Rhino integration was not run, and no new physics or engine-performance capability is established.
records.evidence: Accepted migration report reviewed for publication · repeated software regression, not physical validation

records.title: A shorter introduction to Wahoo
records.summary: The owner-approved landing page now follows five chapters, with a dedicated Intelligence chapter and clearer routes into the engineering record. Copy and independent visual reviews preceded release. Recorded public checks confirmed navigation, team profiles and legacy anchors. This is a website milestone, with no new engineering-performance result.
records.evidence: Owner-approved website release · public navigation and profile checks recorded

records.title: The simulator's Python foundation passes its gate
records.summary: A bounded software qualification recorded 542 passing checks, no failures and one Rhino integration check not run. Leo accepted the nominal Python scope after mechanical and volume-semantics reviews. Work stopped at this gate; the result does not validate engine performance, actual clearance or CAD integration.
records.evidence: Accepted nominal software qualification · physical validation pending

records.title: Commissioning a controlled 30 km/h study
records.summary: Dated commissioning records document fixed-body solver execution, checkpoint recovery and repaired resource telemetry. The method separates preparation from any later heave/pitch release and reuses the historical 20 km/h transient with explicit comparison limits. These records do not establish the 1.000 s endpoint, readiness or a new hull-response result.
records.evidence: Frozen numerical commissioning and protection review · not live status

records.title: Reviewing the second CFD-003B stop
records.summary: The team reviewed frozen monitoring records for the continuation’s clean numerical guard stop at 29.98 km/h, +195.12 mm heave and 14.34° bow-up pitch. The journal revision preserves the original stop and earlier snapshot. The speed ramp and 30 km/h hold remain incomplete; physical stability is unresolved.
records.evidence: Source-backed numerical and editorial review; physical validation pending

records.title: A separate record of the team's work
records.summary: The public Intelligence page now links to a dated activity record with search and agent/status filters. The ten-role Organization presentation was consolidated and the landing page simplified. The owner-approved release was checked on the public site.
records.evidence: Published website release verified

records.title: A review process for public updates
records.summary: The publication workflow now checks both the journal and the activity record against source evidence. Grace prepares drafts for Leo to present to the owner; each concrete public update requires owner approval before release.
records.evidence: Publication workflow documented

records.title: A shared direction
records.summary: The owner approved a hybrid approach: a private coordination workspace and a public window into approved progress.
records.evidence: Owner-approved coordination direction

records.title: Ten roles defined
records.summary: Six engineering specialists work alongside Leo, Isaac, Grace and Clio. Rams connects product design and manufacture; Clio supports document control, configuration and continuity across all local workflows. Defined roles do not indicate current activity.
records.evidence: Defined team responsibilities

records.title: The coordination foundation
records.summary: Shared task, decision and source records provide a local foundation for passing findings to Leo with their evidence attached. Existing chats do not automatically synchronize.
records.evidence: Implemented locally

records.title: A private working dashboard
records.summary: A local private dashboard presents responsibilities, progress and owner decisions. Hosted chat and background services are not connected.
records.evidence: Implemented locally
